steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each gap is matched to a course in the catalogue. A gap with no course is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 gap has no training in the catalogue

findings.title: Gap with no training in the catalogue
findings.fix: Add a course or source one

findings.title: Competency level with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the level

outcome.notChecked: Whether the training would close the gap.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks a gap with no training in the catalogue, and a competency level with no source.
cons: Not checked: Whether the training would close the gap.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-training-needs-analysis skill on the records for this review.
